events.text: You collect worms after the rain and declare them a sect of worms.

effects.log: They do not improve. You do, in patience.
The worm sect goes out into the world.

events.text: You fold a paper boat and race it down the gutter against other children's boats.

effects.log: Your boat wins the gutter championship.

choices.text: Let it sail to the river

effects.log: Somewhere, a paper boat sails to the sea.

events.text: You wake from a nightmare about a masked swordsman.

effects.log: A warm hand on your head until you sleep.
You stare at the dark until it is only dark.

events.text: You climb onto the roof to watch the sunset. Getting down is harder.

effects.log: You land badly and proudly.
A neighbour brings a ladder and a lecture.

events.text: You try to count every star in the sky.

effects.log: You fall asleep at four hundred and twelve.
Every star now has a silly name.

events.text: Your front tooth falls out. You throw it onto the roof, as tradition says, so the new one grows straight.

effects.log: It lands perfectly. The new tooth grows straight.
A strange treasure.

events.text: A duck steals your rice cake and waddles away with it.

ok.log: You get the rice cake back. Covered in mud. Worth it.

fail.log: The duck wins. It always wins.

effects.log: The duck deserves it more.

events.text: You try to catch fish with your bare hands in the stream.

ok.log: One fish! You carry it home like treasure.

choices.text: Watch how the herons do it

effects.log: Patience, then speed.

events.text: A kitten is crying under the bridge in the rain.

effects.log: It becomes the fattest cat in the village.
A little roof of boards. It stays dry.

events.text: You make a sword out of bamboo and duel every child in the lane.

fail.log: Beaten by a girl half your size. She is a genius.

effects.log: The lane becomes a school.

events.text: The old well at the edge of the village is said to have a dragon at the bottom.

effects.log: A long splash. No dragon. Probably.
It does not answer. You are a little disappointed.

events.text: You read your first whole book by yourself. It takes a month.

effects.log: Better the second time.
Everyone knows the plot now.

events.text: A rider gallops through the village. You run after the horse as far as you can.

effects.log: Your legs are jelly. Your heart is a horse.
Some day.

events.text: A merchant lets off fireworks for his son's birthday. The whole village gathers.

effects.log: Red and gold flowers in the sky.
He shows you. You burn your eyebrow a little.

events.text: You and your best friend wrestle in the grass until neither can stand.

effects.log: Draws are best between friends.
Your friend disagrees loudly for a week.

events.text: You build a scarecrow that looks exactly like the village head.

effects.log: The birds are terrified. So is the village head.

choices.text: Take it down before he sees

effects.log: Wise. The birds come back.

events.text: A sparrow with a broken wing hops in the courtyard.

effects.log: It heals and sits on your windowsill every morning.
You feel bad all week.

events.text: You tell your first big lie, and someone believes it.

effects.log: It feels better than the lie.
It sits in your stomach for a year.

events.text: The sugar-painting man makes a dragon out of hot syrup for you.

effects.log: A sweet dragon.
It melts. You cry a little.

events.text: You try to find where the rainbow touches the ground.

effects.log: It keeps moving. You find a field of flowers instead.
'Where the brave find it,' they say, unhelpfully.

events.text: You practise your fighting stance in front of the mirror for an hour. You look ridiculous.

effects.log: Less ridiculous each day.
Very fierce. Very ridiculous.

events.text: Your first paid work: carrying bricks for a builder all summer.

effects.log: Strong arms and a small purse. (+8 taels)
You find a better way to stack them. The builder is impressed.

events.text: You write a love letter and never send it.

effects.log: It goes up in smoke, like your courage.
You find it years later and laugh.

events.text: You and friends hike to the top of the nearest mountain to watch the sunrise.

effects.log: The sunrise is worth every blister.

choices.text: Turn back when it gets cold

effects.log: Wise. You watch from halfway, still beautiful.

events.text: You have been saving coins in a jar for a year.

effects.log: Cheap iron. Yours. (−5 taels)
The jar grows. (+5 taels)

events.text: You cut your own hair to look like a famous swordsman. It goes wrong.

effects.log: Nobody knows. Everybody knows.
Everyone thinks you are joining a temple.

events.text: An older student scolds you for sloppy footwork in front of everyone.

effects.log: He is surprised, then respects you.
You fix your footwork out of spite.

events.text: Your first night market alone: lanterns, strangers, the smell of frying.

effects.log: A stomach ache and a great memory.
A sword juggler. You try it later with sticks.

events.text: The village teacher sets a debate: should the strong protect the weak?

effects.log: You win. You believe it.
You lose, but everyone remembers.

events.text: Your legs ache at night. You are growing too fast.

effects.log: Flexible and taller.
Everyone hears about your legs.

events.text: You write a letter to a famous master asking to be his student. You never expect an answer.

effects.log: No answer. You keep training.
You train like his student anyway.

events.text: You try to learn the flute. The neighbours move away.

effects.log: By winter you can play one song. The neighbours move back.
The neighbours thank you.

events.text: You spend a night at the temple, meditating with the monks.

effects.log: At dawn, a stillness you have never felt.
A monk covers you with a blanket.

events.text: Your best friend's family is moving far away.

effects.log: You write for years.
They keep it forever.

events.text: Your class plans a prank on the strictest teacher.

effects.log: It is brilliant. The punishment is not.
The teacher is grateful. The class is not.
